mapper.sql: ${column} >= CAST(#{periodFrom} AS DATE) AND ${column} < CAST(#{periodTo} AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 day'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_LOG L WHERE

SELECT L.LEVEL AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM TB_LOG L WHERE GROUP BY L.LEVEL ORDER BY CASE UPPER(L.LEVEL) WHEN 'DEBUG' THEN 1 WHEN 'INFO' THEN 2 WHEN 'WARN' THEN 3 WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 3 WHEN 'ERROR' THEN 4 ELSE 9 END, L.LEVEL
SELECT COALESCE(D.DEVICE_NAME, '미등록 장비') AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM TB_LOG L LEFT JOIN TB_DEVICE D ON D.DEVICE_ID = L.DEVICE_ID WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(D.DEVICE_NAME, '미등록 장비') ORDER BY 1

SELECT TO_CHAR(L.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REG_DT, D.DEVICE_NAME, L.LEVEL, L.MESSAGE FROM TB_LOG L LEFT JOIN TB_DEVICE D ON D.DEVICE_ID = L.DEVICE_ID WHERE ORDER BY L.REG_DT DESC, L.ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EVENT E WHERE
SELECT E.EVENT_TYPE AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM TB_EVENT E WHERE GROUP BY E.EVENT_TYPE ORDER BY E.EVENT_TYPE

SELECT TO_CHAR(E.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REG_DT, COALESCE(E.USER_ID, E.ACTOR_USER_ID) AS USER_ID, E.EVENT_TYPE, E.MESSAGE FROM TB_EVENT E WHERE ORDER BY E.REG_DT DESC, E.ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ALARM A WHERE
SELECT A.ALARM_TYPE AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM TB_ALARM A WHERE GROUP BY A.ALARM_TYPE ORDER BY A.ALARM_TYPE

SELECT COALESCE(A.ALARM_LEVEL, '미지정') AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM TB_ALARM A WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(A.ALARM_LEVEL, '미지정') ORDER BY CASE UPPER(COALESCE(A.ALARM_LEVEL, '미지정')) WHEN 'LOW' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN '미지정' THEN 9 ELSE 5 END, 1

SELECT TO_CHAR(A.OCCURRED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS OCCURRED_AT, D.DEVICE_NAME, A.ALARM_TYPE, A.ALARM_LEVEL, A.ALARM_MESSAGE FROM TB_ALARM A LEFT JOIN TB_DEVICE D ON D.DEVICE_ID = A.DEVICE_ID WHERE ORDER BY A.OCCURRED_AT DESC, A.ALARM_ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT 'DCS' AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM public.tb_dcs_data X WHERE UNION ALL SELECT 'KA' AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM public.tb_ka_data X WHERE

SELECT COALESCE(TRIM(X.received_status), '미지정') AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM public.tb_dcs_data X WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(TRIM(X.received_status), '미지정') ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(X.received_status), '미지정') = '미지정' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 1

SELECT COALESCE(TRIM(X.receive_status), '미지정') AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS COUNT FROM public.tb_ka_data X WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(TRIM(X.receive_status), '미지정') ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(X.receive_status), '미지정') = '미지정' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 1

SELECT TO_CHAR(CAST(U.RECEIVED_AT AS DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DAY, SUM(CASE WHEN U.BAND = 'DCS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DCS_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN U.BAND = 'KA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS KA_COUNT FROM ( SELECT X.received_at AS RECEIVED_AT, 'DCS' AS BAND FROM public.tb_dcs_data X WHERE UNION ALL SELECT X.received_at, 'KA' FROM public.tb_ka_data X WHERE ) U GROUP BY CAST(U.RECEIVED_AT AS DATE) ORDER BY CAST(U.RECEIVED_AT AS DATE)

SELECT D.device_id AS DEVICE_ID, D.device_name AS DEVICE_NAME, TRIM(D.device_type) AS DEVICE_TYPE, R.RECEIVE_COUNT AS RECEIVE_COUNT, TO_CHAR(R.LAST_RECEIVED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_RECEIVED_AT FROM public.tb_device D JOIN ( SELECT U.DEVICE_ID, COUNT(*) AS RECEIVE_COUNT, MAX(U.RECEIVED_AT) AS LAST_RECEIVED_AT FROM ( SELECT X.device_id AS DEVICE_ID, X.received_at AS RECEIVED_AT FROM public.tb_dcs_data X WHERE UNION ALL SELECT X.device_id, X.received_at FROM public.tb_ka_data X WHERE ) U GROUP BY U.DEVICE_ID ) R ON R.DEVICE_ID = D.device_id ORDER BY D.device_id

SELECT TO_CHAR(U.RECEIVED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS RECEIVED_AT, D.device_name AS DEVICE_NAME, U.BAND, U.PAYLOAD, U.STATUS FROM ( SELECT X.device_id AS DEVICE_ID, X.received_at AS RECEIVED_AT, 'DCS' AS BAND, LEFT(CAST(X.data_payload AS TEXT), 200) AS PAYLOAD, TRIM(X.received_status) AS STATUS FROM public.tb_dcs_data X WHERE UNION ALL SELECT X.device_id, X.received_at, 'KA', CAST(X.file_name AS TEXT), TRIM(X.receive_status) FROM public.tb_ka_data X WHERE ) U LEFT JOIN public.tb_device D ON D.device_id = U.DEVICE_ID ORDER BY U.RECEIVED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit}
